changes.description: Initial snapshot: the subcommand→capability-requirement table as committed when the drift guard landed. Breaks nothing — this records the live contract as-is; motivated by #2386 (TBH-1) silently narrowing backlog-dedupe/gather-issue-context/gather-pr-context requirements and breaking every shipped config.

Require exact separately brokered issue-read capabilities for built-in commands so issue-write grants cannot release GOOBERS_CRED_GITHUB_ISSUES_READ; existing workflows that need issue reads must declare the explicit read capability.

Add pr-comment-watch: label open goober PRs carrying unaddressed human comments (github:issues:write via label-issue). Purely additive — a new command with one requirement; no existing command's requirements change, so every shipped config keeps compiling.

Add file-issues (#2251, TBH-1 first slice): the nomination workflows' deterministic issue filer. --check requires the exact github:issues:read grant for the dedupe scan; the write path requires github:issues:write. The filer never applies goobers:approved (the SEC-047 trust label is a maintainer's decision), so it declares no github:issues:approve requirement. Purely additive — a new command; no existing command's requirements change, so every shipped config keeps compiling.

file-issues (#2251, decision 004): declare github:issues:approve as an OPTIONAL use. The filer applies goobers:approved only to a nomination whose evidence matches a deterministic tool finding (go vet / golangci-lint / go test) byte for byte, and only when the autoApprove=deterministic-only INPUT opts in — the manifest sees only args, so it cannot require the credential on that input; admission requires it through the policy table instead (the input prescribes approve-issue, whose contract requires github:issues:approve). The label add goes through the approve credential alone. Optional is never required, so no shipped config's admission changes.
